errors.title: Query without owner
errors.message: This query on Order does not say which user's rows it reads
errors.fix: Add `user: CurrentUser` to the parameters of `list`, then `.owned_by(&user)` right after `Order::query()`: the query returns only this user's orders. A screen that needs every order uses `.all_owners("reason")`, which needs human approval.
